protocol.domain: Reuse the exact eight V15 submitted original CSR/RHS/bounds and fixed actual first 48h. Preserve direct fuel shortage=0, all daily debt deadlines and free/full end SOC. Do not rerun or change the original rolling baselines or ENS minimizations.
protocol.objective: Actual physical resource cost at the certified original minimum ENS plus the unchanged 1e-6 GWh cap. Retain all operating, fuel, cycling, shift, net SOC draw and holding constants. No carbon-charge or shortage-penalty term.
protocol.carbon_cap: Primary h48..359 actual combustion CO2 no greater than the paired rolling path. Since direct fuel service is fixed, constrain the exact coal+gas generation emissions vector against that vector evaluated on the saved rolling baseline. No additional carbon allowance.
protocol.peak_cap: Every primary-hour electricity ENS <= paired rolling primary peak in GW. Tighten all unserved upper bounds; no additional peak allowance.
protocol.comparisons: All eight conditions times carbon-only, peak-only, joint limits, compared with the same rolling baseline and V15 unconstrained resource minimum. Keep every signed metric, all terminal fuel/SOC/thermal/debt states and any failure. No post-result arm, phase, or threshold selection.
protocol.information: All new paths still receive the complete true remaining 312h once at h48. This evaluates achievable tradeoffs in the matched model domain; it does not isolate forecast value or establish an implementable rolling-controller improvement.
protocol.verification: Verify each saved baseline inclusion before its one LP; save submitted matrices, exact solution and all marginals; validate primal/dual/KKT; replay all 360 actions through the original physical transition, original and independent audits; match first 48h and full h48 branch state; reconcile actual resource, CO2, ENS and peak against the submitted vectors.

metrics.information_contract: Fixed actual h0..47; full true h48..359 once; baseline carbon/peak limits
metrics.stock_holding_assumption: 5 percent/year on committed initial fuel inventory value, prorated by modeled hours; engineering capital charge, not observed storage tariff. Reported separately and not a dispatch decision cost.
metrics.valuation_scope: Declared constant engineering unit values. Fuel arrivals plus initial-minus-terminal stock equal consumption; coal/gas unit values reproduce generation fuel costs. Nonfossil operating costs are separate. SOC draw is charged at a common 0.32 million CNY/GWh. Not observed market prices or national welfare.
metrics.boundary: Single aggregate bus, continuous ramp-constrained plants; no unit commitment, spatial network or empirical hourly calibration. Hydro is an exogenous available-flow bound. Arrivals are domestic/import flows, not unconstrained balancing fuel. Daily flexible-load deadlines and final zero debt; storage terminal state is reported, not forced cyclic.

original_physical_audit.interpretation: Actions and end states are independently reconstructed; state-accounting verification is not empirical hourly validation.
